dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a minimal concave curvature, ascending almost vertically from the dorsal ridge before rounding into the apex, indicating a very low degree of falcation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The fin's highest morphological point exhibits a small-radius rounded shape, transitioning smoothly between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a steep, relatively linear trajectory at an approximate 70-degree angle relative to the segmented horizontal dorsal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The fin is characterized by a narrow profile with a base-width-to-total-height ratio of approximately 0.4.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High density of small, white, circular and semi-circular punctate lesions/marks distributed across the entire visible lateral surface of the dorsal fin and adjacent back.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly specific and dense spatial distribution of white depigmentation spots across the dark grey pigmentation of the fin is a primary unique identifier.
